PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp (10-14 weeks postpartum)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore baseline strength and movement"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-ramp Phase" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Acclimatisation - Full body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          standing_row 0x0 rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
          hinge_practice 0x0 rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Lower emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Strength foundation - Full body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Upper focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progressive overload - Full body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 75 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core stability & single-leg":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 0x0 rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Upper + posterior":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Build baseline - Full body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7..8 rest 75 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core resilience":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Preparation for progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
